title: Ten endpoints, ranked by tail latency
description: bar length = p99 in ms · red where the route breaches the objective · ranked slowest first, aggregated from a five-minute window

props.name: data
props.description: Application observations with route and p99Ms. Request-rate metadata is not required; samples are kept in the registry example.

props.name: objectiveMs
props.description: Nonnegative p99 objective; invalid objectives leave bars unclassified.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot aspect ratio.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills the containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.

props.name: label
props.description: Label beside the current breach count.

props.name: source
props.description: Source text in the existing status footer.

props.name: window
props.description: Measurement window in the existing status footer.

props.name: updated
props.description: Caller-supplied freshness text in the existing status footer.
